# SubZero Keyosk v2.0 (Bitcoin Testnet4 Cold Vault & Airgap PSBT Signer)

> Airgapped, zero-OS-RNG Bitcoin Testnet4 (`BIP-94`) key ceremony, PSBT airgap signer, `BIP-85` child-vault manager, and `pipe-k1` release-signing workspace built on one pure-Rust core (`subzero-core`) compiling bit-for-bit deterministically to Bare-Metal Linux (`x86_64-unknown-linux-musl`) and zero-import Single-File WebAssembly HTML (`subzero-keyosk.html` & `decrypt.html`).

## Documentation Index

- [README.md](README.md): Quickstart, Cooperative Two-Tier Entropy (Tier 1 Coins/Dice/Hardware Hex vs Tier 2 100-Char Obstacle Course & Tier 2B Free-Form Keys/Arrows), 10 funded Testnet4 rehearsal presets (`Preset 0..9`), headless CLI subcommands, reproducible container build, and dual PGP + `pipe-k1` release verification.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Rust workspace layout (`crates/subzero-core`, `crates/subzero-tui`, `crates/subzero-wasm`), WASM secret isolation and scrubbing ABI, `subzero-vault-v2` SIV AES-256-GCM format, and two-partition UEFI RAM-only (`initramfs` + `memtester-static`) appliance architecture.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): Threat model, trust boundaries, scope limits (Testnet4 single-sig `BIP-84` + `BIP-86`), v2.0 security remediation table, and verification workflow.

## Release Artifacts & Public Keys

- `dist/subzero-x86_64-musl`: Static Linux console + headless CLI (`--self-test`, `derive`, `inspect-psbt`, `sign-psbt`, `vault-seal`, `vault-unseal`, `seedfix`, `descriptor-checksum`).
- `dist/subzero-keyosk.html`: Standalone offline `file://` HTML/WASM kiosk (CSP hash-pinned, zero network, zero external dependencies, WASM-isolated secrets).
- `dist/decrypt.html`: Standalone offline `file://` HTML/WASM decryptor for `subzero-vault-v2` `vault.json` estate bundles.
- `bootlace-dev-pgp.asc` / `bootlace-dev-release.asc`: OpenPGP key `F181 73E5 5464 4BB5 9018  AE50 F6E9 6FAD CA2E 8E0F`.
- `bootlace-dev-pipek1.pub`: `pipe-k1` (`m/83696968'/128002'`) key `npub1mvlht4wj3lvfmw96qxakaln862r27nn7z84ak089zjuvavkppeeq79a4j7`.
